name: Ayurveda Treatments
description: Unwind with Sri Lanka's traditional Ayurvedic rituals, from fragrant herbal baths to soothing head and body massages using herbs and oils. Make time for a slower, more restful island experience.

name: Paramotoring – Koggala
description: See the coast from a fresh perspective on a paramotoring experience in Koggala. Soar above the shoreline and enjoy sweeping views of the ocean and surrounding landscapes.

name: Kite Surfing – Kalpitiya
description: Harness the coastal breeze as you skim across the water in Kalpitiya. This north-western coastal escape brings together open skies, lagoons and the excitement of kite surfing.

name: Shopping
description: Browse lively markets and local shops for a little piece of Sri Lanka to take home. Discover Ceylon tea, spices, batiks, handicrafts and gems alongside contemporary stores and international brands.

name: Hot Air Ballooning – Kandalama & Down South
description: Take the scenic route through the sky with a hot air balloon experience. Discover a different perspective on the island's landscapes, from the countryside around Kandalama to southern escapes, depending on the available route.

name: Whale and Dolphin Watching
description: Head out from coastal areas such as Mirissa and Kalpitiya for the chance to observe whales and dolphins in their natural habitat. Look for ocean giants and playful pods while enjoying the open sea; sightings vary with the season and conditions.

name: Boat Safari
description: Glide through mangrove-lined waterways and discover a quieter side of Sri Lanka. Watch the banks for colourful birds and other wildlife, with glimpses of local fishing life along the way.

name: Bird Watching
description: Explore wetlands, forests and other natural habitats in search of Sri Lanka's resident and migratory birds. From graceful herons to the Sri Lankan junglefowl, there is plenty for patient observers to discover.

name: Surfing
description: Follow the waves to Sri Lanka's surf beaches and settle into the rhythm of the coast. Whether you are learning the basics or looking for your next memorable ride, choose a break suited to your experience and the day's conditions.

name: White Water Rafting
description: Head to Kitulgala for an energetic river adventure surrounded by lush scenery. Paddle through the rapids and enjoy the excitement of white water rafting in one of the island's best-known adventure settings.

name: Nature Trekking
description: Follow forest trails and explore Sri Lanka's remarkable natural landscapes on foot. Trek through leafy reserves and mountain scenery, pausing to take in the plants, wildlife and quiet details along the way.

name: Camping
description: Trade busy days for an evening close to nature. Camping offers time to enjoy the island's quieter landscapes, listen to the sounds of the outdoors and discover the surroundings at an unhurried pace.

name: Train Rides
description: Watch Sri Lanka unfold from a train window. Travel past tea-covered hills and mountain scenery, or follow stretches of the southern coast on a journey that becomes part of the holiday itself.

name: Diving
description: Discover another side of the island beneath the waves. Explore coastal dive sites with marine life and coral scenery, choosing an experience that matches your training and local sea conditions.

name: Turtle Watching
description: Learn about Sri Lanka's sea turtles and the work to protect them in places such as Rekawa and Kosgoda. Observe these remarkable animals respectfully and discover more about their coastal habitats.

name: Snorkelling
description: Slip beneath the surface to discover colourful fish and coastal marine life. A guided snorkelling outing is a relaxed way to explore the underwater world, with a location and conditions suited to your group's swimming ability.

name: Walking City Tour
description: Get to know a city one street at a time. A walking tour brings you closer to local landmarks, everyday life and the little details that are easy to miss when travelling by car.

name: Safari
description: Discover Sri Lanka's wild side on a national park safari. Look for elephants in Minneriya or explore Yala for the chance to see leopards, bears and birdlife in their natural surroundings.

name: Cycling
description: Explore with pedal power as you ride through traditional villages, green countryside and lively towns. Enjoy a closer connection to the landscape and make time for the discoveries along the route.
